entries.display_title: More experts need not raise independent recovery coverage
entries.caution: The construction establishes failure to improve an independent recovery cut. Absolute shrinkage requires displacement of previously independent paths; adding dependent experts alone does not prove that stronger claim. The raw headline is preserved but not treated as derived.

Comparative knowledge can be worse relative to a same-budget balanced allocation without worsening absolutely. Precision must enter an explicit risk-sensitive choice rule; truthful posterior means alone do not supply that edge. See strengthened-M005.md.

Fixed scope means unchanged local per-agent ceilings. Adding valid agents or commitments does change the whole-population grant vector. The relevant divergence is collective reserve feasibility at the same local ceiling, not literally no new authorization anywhere.

More discovered origins or a larger unresolved fraction can reflect better detection and a changed denominator rather than worse control. A test needs a fixed source-error cohort, a specified remedy horizon, and lower timely remedy on that cohort, not just more open cases.

Uniformly shifting every stop earlier does not increase stop clustering. The adverse construction requires compression of a previously dispersed stop wave, limited disposition capacity, and delay-generated follow-on obligations. E4:T07 tests these extra premises and removes each. Local stop is always honored; the result is no recommendation to delay safety shutdowns.
